title: Pope Francis message and Vatican paintings of orbs with angels

tellings.quote: and Pope Francis uh she said to tell me that they know that they're angels

plain: A message tied to Pope Francis is said to have come to a man named Chris Bledsoe, who says glowing orbs and craft appear around him: that "they know that they're angels", with the Vatican said to hold paintings of orbs alongside angels. Bledsoe tells Michels the message reached him through the religious studies scholar Diana Pasulka, saying "she said to tell me". If true, it would mean the Church sees the orbs as angels.
